title: Kagamine Rin — Pop Out SEKAI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you both like something to drink?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were you practicing with Kohane and the other today too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! They even said that they're gonna be in another event tomorrow or the day after!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, another one? They really are busy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They won that other event... Uh, STAY GOLDEN, right? So all these other events want them to join now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're starting to become quite famous, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, what kind of events are they entering into next?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: From what I understand, there are events where teams compete against one another to see who can get the crowd going the most and others where they simply perform together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... They said their next one is a battle...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever seen one of their events before.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we ask them really nicely and see if we can go check one out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! We can go see them now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright!
Thanks for the melon soda, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
H-Hey, wait!
You didn't actually answer my question...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I understand that they want to see them right this second, but aren't they all in school right now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go get lunch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Did my phone just flash...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hiya! We came here to see you!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, that was way too close...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hahaha. You had no idea that we'd be coming, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How was I supposed to know? Also, how does this stupid thing even work?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Who knows? The only part I got is how we can jump between phones with Untitled on them!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you're saying that you can jump to Toya or An or Kohane's phone too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! But Kohane goes to a different school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why we decided to try you first, Akito. So where are Toya and An?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We're in different classes.
An's probably having lunch with her classmates and I'm guessing Toya's busy with library committee stuff.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, why are you here?
You're not seriously here to play or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, right. We're here to ask you something!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We wanna see one of your guys' events next time!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! We really wanna see you guys performing in one of these!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And we were wondering if you could use your phone to take us to a venue next time like you are now!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Please, Akito!
You can even leave us just off stage!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess it wouldn't be too hard so...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. Our next event includes pretty much only people we know, so it should be safe for me to leave my phone behind for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've helped us a bunch already, so I guess we owe you at least that much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Thank you so much, Akito!
We can't wait!>
